【原视频简介】
Claude Fable 5.1 is cheaper than Fable 5 and, in this one-shot test, it actually designs better. Same prompt, high effort, two Claude Code sessions.

Join CreatorNTWRK 👇
https://discord.com/invite/vZxn6wZrDD
https://www.skool.com/builderzgym

I ran Fable 5.1 and Fable 5 on the same brief: a minimalist landing page for the Morikami Museum and Japanese Gardens, real photos, creative copy. 5.1 gives you a sticky hero, an editorial timeline, and layouts that make sense. Fable 5 looks more robotic, blows out the hero image, and goes so cute with the copy you lose the gardens. Then I run the same site-audit skill on both. 5.1’s writeup is easier to scan, and applying the fixes is faster.

What you will learn:
- What’s actually new in Fable 5.1 vs Fable 5 (price, accuracy, fewer shortcuts)
- The X builds people are already shipping (Blender walkthrough, two-prompt Titanic game)
- The exact one-shot museum prompt I used
- Side-by-side landing pages at high effort
- Why 5.1 still falls into the italic dual-color hero slop
- Auditing a live site with a skill on both models
